<!--
Before you file: `glyphmark <cmd> --help`, `glyphmark schemes`, and the docs at /docs/
(`uv run glyphmark docs build`). Questions that were already answered in docs get turned
into a docs edit plus a link - that is a win, not a dismissal.

If the text you are asking about belongs to someone else, replace it with synthetic text of
the same shape. Real-world samples of hidden marks are how people get identified.
-->
